sizes.air: up to 25 bar via regulator, remote clip-on chuck

footprint.note: bolted to the floor; the gate swings out over +y

reference: No usable free photo found; published sizes of aircraft tyre inflation cages and A320 tyres

parts.name: Frame
parts.move: root: the cage, bolted to the hangar floor

parts.name: Gate
parts.move: swings about z on the left hinge pins: 0 = shut and latched .. 100 deg open (wheel in / out)

parts.name: Chuck
parts.move: off the hook by hand, clipped onto the tyre valve (hose follows); back on the hook after

parts.name: Needle_Line
parts.move: turns about its local z (out of the dial) 0..270 deg clockwise from -135: air line pressure (0..25 bar)

parts.name: Gauge_Tyre
parts.move: fixed: tyre pressure read through the hose (0..25 bar)

parts.name: Needle_Tyre
parts.move: turns about its local z (out of the dial) 0..270 deg clockwise from -135: tyre pressure read through the hose (0..25 bar)

parts.name: Regulator
parts.move: turns about the panel normal 0..270 deg: sets the fill pressure, never above the tyre limit

parts.name: InflateValve
parts.move: quarter turn about the panel normal 0..90 deg: open = air flows to the tyre

parts.name: DeflateValve
parts.move: turns about the panel normal 0..270 deg (open): bleeds the tyre down

controls.does: lift the latch and swing open to roll the wheel in; shut and latch before filling
clip onto the wheel valve through the bars, then step back to the panel
sets the fill pressure, never above the tyre limit
open = air flows to the tyre
